lines.hook: How many charges is your battery built for?
lines.cycle: First, one cycle means using a hundred percent in total. Sixty today, plus forty tomorrow, is one cycle.
lines.chart: Apple rates the iPhone 14 and older for five hundred cycles to eighty percent capacity. iPhone 15, iPad, MacBook and Apple Watch get a thousand.
lines.years: At one cycle a day, that's under three years. Keep it cool to make every cycle count.
lines.outro: Check yours in Settings, Battery. And follow for more.
